messages.subject: International Executive Profile | Mining, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Alder Koten Team,

I am introducing my profile for senior cross-border leadership mandates where executive search, industrial growth and institutional stakeholder management intersect. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments across mining, energy, infrastructure and adjacent industrial sectors. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
